assumptions: Rate method: assumed_net_rate
Pointing: ideal_pointing
Service: SYNTHETIC windows at both endpoints; no booked network service
Sky directions and skylines are invented Phase 3 inputs held at the fixed absolute horizon.
Contact geometry is declared synthetic interval-wide input, not a computed mission opportunity.
Rates are assumed net payload bits per second; light time is disabled only for the synthetic fixture.
Changing coordinates, heights, station geometry, trajectory or analysis extent requires new analysis inputs.
left_sample_piecewise_constant_assumption
Battery diagnostic includes base load only; no radio schedule was selected.
Fixed-panel center-ray projection times sampled uniform solar disk fraction.
Spherical opaque Earth eclipse mask combined with terrain on the same solar samples.
Contact event guard is explicitly zero for this diagnostic; not an operational margin.
Whole dataset uses direct contacts or one selected lunar store-and-forward relay; Earth-orbit relays disabled.
Payload durations rounded upward to an event-grid boundary; padded payload occupancy consumes declared radio power.
Radio conflicts and electrical loads conservatively reserve every intersected event bin.
Acquisition and teardown use the terminal TX or RX electrical draw respectively.
Relay buffer reserves a complete chunk at reception start and releases it after outgoing payload completion.
Ground sink retains all received chunks with finite configured station storage.
Policy: satisfy deadline and constraints, then fewer relay hops, earlier final arrival, lower lander communications energy.
SYNTHETIC external relay power assumed sufficient only during declared service; battery/base loads not modeled
Ground stations use externally powered service; station battery/base loads are outside the frozen profile.
summary.limiting_reason: The complete dataset schedule passed independent byte, timing, resource and energy replay under the declared assumptions.

details.availability_policy: declared availability may conservatively delay physical availability
details.buffer_conservatism: reserve incoming whole chunk at first arrival; release at transmit end
details.external_power: relay and station power follows explicit profile assumptions
details.setup_power_assumption: acquisition and teardown draw the respective TX/RX electrical watts
